feeds.title: ICG Magazine
feeds.description: ICG Magazine has been the world's premier cinematography publication since 1929. The International Cinematographers Guild (ICG) represents the most talented camera professionals and publicists in the world. The technicians and artisans in our union are the creators of the visual images on the big screen, the television screen and our computer screen.

feeds.title: Noam Kroll - Cinematography
feeds.description: Insight, Reviews and Tips on Filmmaking, Cinematography & Post Production.

feeds.title: Wandering DP
feeds.description: A site dedicated to Digital Cinematography & Leica M photography. Get all the latest news and updates from The Wandering DP Podcast. The Wandering DP Podcast is your home for cinematography interviews and breakdowns.

feeds.title: British Cinematographer
feeds.description: Since 2004, British Cinematographer Magazine has developed and evolved into as an essential read for cinematographers and all those associated with the art of cinematography. Our bi-monthly publication magazine has expanded from its British-focused origins to also encompass the talents of the greatest cinematographers worldwide - whether they are working on small-budget independents or the largest Hollywood blockbusters, shooting on celluloid or digital.

feeds.title: The Making Of
feeds.description: 'The Making Of' explores the creative pros behind-the-scenes of today's top films, TV shows, documentaries and news content.

feeds.title: Evan E. Richards Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Evan E. Richards. A visual effects artist/cinematographer/director with more than 10 years of experience.

feeds.title: johnbrawley
feeds.description: Working with vision, speed and an inherently collaborative nature, John Brawley has developed a reputation as one of Australia's most talented and sought after Directors of Photography. Since graduating with an MA from the Australian Film Television and Radio School, he has built an impressive slate of feature films and television credits including some of Australia's most loved shows.

feeds.title: Matt Porwoll Blog
feeds.description: A Cinematography blog by cinematographer Matt Porwoll.

feeds.title: IronBird Aerial Cinematography
feeds.description: IronBird Aerial Cinematography Ltd is a leading UK provider of remotely piloted drones for the use of aerial photography and aerial filming. Our experience and airframes enable us to lift camera payloads up to and including the Red Dragon and Arri Alexa Mini.

feeds.title: Cinematography Database
feeds.description: Cinematography Database is the training ground for Modern Cinematographers and the creator of Cine Designer.
